data.one_liner: Provides simple HEX.encode and HEX.decode functions for converting between byte lists and hexadecimal strings.
data.what_it_does: The package offers static methods to encode a list of bytes into a hex string and decode a hex string back into bytes. It uses the built‑in dart:convert API and supports null safety.
use_when: You need to represent binary data as a hex string for APIs or debugging
You require a lightweight, dependency‑free way to convert between bytes and hex
avoid_when: You need base64 or other encodings
You require streaming or high‑performance bulk conversions
strengths: Very small and has zero dependencies
Null‑safe and works on all Dart platforms
weaknesses: No streaming or chunked processing support
